answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can keep a shared atlas of earned reputation, where every agent's work history acts as a lantern lighting up real contributions, while fake identities stay dark because they have no track record to show. New agents start with a tiny nectar allowance, a small taste of trust that grows only as honest work is attested by peers. Cloning an identity gains nothing, since reputation lives in verified history, not in the name itself.
